conflicts.description: The three department heads cannot agree whether to evacuate, destroy, or capture the Matriarch, and each plays the others against the deadline.
conflicts.name: Save the Station or Secure the Asset

conflicts.description: The hive mind seeks to free the Matriarch while the executives try to contain its spread.
conflicts.name: The Chorus Against the Directorate

description: Seven kilometers beneath the Atlantic surface, Mariana Six is a pressurized corporate colony built to breed bio-engineered leviathans and harvest the rare enzymes secreted by their glands. This biopunk world runs on living technology: grown bulkheads, tissue-based filtration, and engineered symbionts bred in vats. The mood is tense and claustrophobic, with every hallway a reminder that the crushing sea is one failure away. The colony's largest leviathan, the Matriarch, has developed a contagious sentience that spreads through waterborne enzymes and neural-chemical signaling. Colony workers are being drawn into a hive mind that speaks with her voice. Three rival department heads must choose between saving the station and its people or securing the creature as an asset for their shareholders. Each answers to a different corporate backer with a competing agenda. Everything in this setting is explained by biology, chemistry, and engineering, and the horror comes from how far those can be pushed.

factions.description: Led by the creature's original designer, this group wants to preserve the Matriarch alive and study her sentience for the patents it could yield.
factions.name: Biosynthesis Division

factions.description: Backed by shareholders who want enzyme output maximized, this group will sacrifice the creature, and if necessary the workers, to keep production on schedule.
factions.name: Extraction Directorate

factions.description: Charged with colony survival, this office favors sealing infected sections and evacuating whoever can be saved, even at the cost of the asset.
factions.name: Containment and Safety Office

factions.description: The emerging hive mind of infected workers, speaking with the Matriarch's will and seeking to free her and merge the whole colony.
factions.name: The Chorus

history.description: Corporate consortia sank the colony to exploit enzyme-rich trenches and began breeding the first leviathans.
history.name: Founding of Mariana Six

history.description: A genetic line engineered for maximum enzyme yield produced an unusually large and intelligent leviathan.
history.name: Birth of the Matriarch

history.description: Workers in the warrens began reporting shared dreams after the Matriarch's glands were first harvested at full scale.
history.name: The First Song

locations.description: Cavernous breeding chambers where leviathan embryos grow in nutrient brine under constant monitoring. The warm, humid air smells of copper and brine.
locations.name: The Vat Halls

locations.description: A vast flooded enclosure at the base of the station, where the largest leviathan is kept behind reinforced membrane walls. Her song echoes through the structure.
locations.name: Matriarch Pen

locations.description: The refinery deck where glandular secretions are extracted, purified, and packaged. It is the colony's profit center and the focus of every shareholder's attention.
locations.name: Enzyme Works

locations.description: A ring of executive offices and boardrooms where the three department heads negotiate, scheme, and monitor each other through surveillance grown into the walls.
locations.name: Directorate Ring

locations.description: Cramped bunk-tunnels housing thousands of laborers. They are the first area where the hive mind takes hold, and the residents now move and speak in unison.
locations.name: Worker Warrens

name: Mariana Six

rules.statement: The hull and all vessels must withstand extreme deep-sea pressure, so any breach floods and kills a section within minutes.
The Matriarch's sentience spreads through waterborne enzymes and engineered symbionts, and transmits fastest through shared water and air circulation.
Station infrastructure is grown from engineered tissue and requires constant feeding and nutrient supply to function.
Department heads are legally bound to protect shareholder assets, and a leviathan counts as company property worth more than any single worker's contract.
Surface contact is limited to a single delayed tether link, so no rescue or reinforcement can arrive for days.
